plan.selection: SHA256(train-probe-v1/task/sample), first 12 distinct train tasks; first and last eligible action, prompt<=8192, first128 response tokens
plan.scope: Fixed train-only teacher-forced histories; descriptive sample, not full rollout KL or dev/test optimization

notes: Both adapters share the frozen base; no optimizer/backward or new trajectories.
Exact categorical KL over vocabulary at fixed sampled training histories, not on-policy rollout KL.
sampled_k3 is a value at old-policy sampled tokens; it is not an unbiased estimate of KL under updated rollouts.
Token argmax disagreements do not equal end-to-end task failures; sample is not full train distribution.
